'''Arjur''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who spent [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] living with members of the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in their hive in an effort to learn more about their culture through immersion in it. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] finally returned from the Kubaz, Arjur had developed a craving for dried [[Moon moth/Legends|moon moths]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arjur was mentioned in the "Jedi Cultural Immersion" Codex entry in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
